oneMainObjective: Capture scoped CFON field egress and owner Windows recovery-readiness verification while preserving current working connection.

cfonCountry.meaning: Confirmed browser-proxy egress change, NOT full-system VPN, all-destination privacy, or guaranteed country permanence.

challenge.meaning: Curl client challenge, not proof of a broken CFON transport or successful interactive browser authentication.

independentRecovery.decision: Retain active session guard. Do not configure system-wide SSH/WinRM/RDP or force disconnection without a separately proven and authorized recovery route.

windowsStorageReadOnly.caveat: Name-based classification only; no evidence that those files are safe to remove.

selectedSnapshot.type: Windows DPAPI CurrentUser encrypted ZIP of 9 chosen settings/identity files
selectedSnapshot.scope: Only selected 9 files; excludes 6+ GiB mutable browser profiles, caches, jobs and session state.

evidenceHierarchy: Local runtime curl and file SHA results, source/tests, accepted GitHub 10/10 CI. Source CI verification distinct from installed field validation.

methods.InnoSetup: Same AppId/same install mode for updates, validated on hosted Windows fresh and R53->R54->R53 rollback; live owner guard intentionally prevents updating a connected provider.
methods.Cloudflare: cf-mitigated: challenge is a server-origin Challenge Page, not a passing HTTP site access test.
methods.DPAPI: CryptProtectData CurrentUser generally restricts decryption to the same Windows user and computer; not a general disaster-recovery backup.
methods.Tailscale: Tailscale SSH server cannot run on Windows; Tailscale ping only tests peer reachability, not authenticated SSH/RDP/WinRM or failover.
methods.WindowsOpenSSH: Microsoft recommends elevated setup/start/firewall controls for Windows OpenSSH Server; Windows host is not elevated and no existing service was found. Adding a privileged service for one test would be disproportionate.

rootCause.issue: R54 live in-place install not executed
rootCause.reason: Owner Windows CFON session connected and installer guard active; no independently authenticated recoverable Windows control channel, WinRM/RDP/SSH inactive.
rootCause.prevention: Do not bypass guard, force terminate provider, reroute Tailscale, silently accept WARP ToS, or promote release from CI alone.
rootCause.regression: 10/10 postmerge source CI; Windows 2/2 isolated R53->R54->R53 test; live two-host CFON HTTPS204 and country trace. Physical owner upgrade still not tested.

accepted: Scoped live browser CFON egress country changes
Selected owner R53 settings archive DPAPI decrypt-and-hash verified
Source/CI and current runtime file hashes
blocked: PC TUN and Linux WARP native whole-system validation
Public R54 stable release rights and field testing
Mobile functional forwarding and Apple entitlements
rejected: Deleting browser caches based on names
Self-provisioning new privileged Windows remote service as a substitute for independent recovery acceptance

materialChange.hostConfigs: No changes to app, network, DNS or routes
materialChange.localWindowsSelectedEncryptedSnapshot: Created exactly once and separately integrity-verified
materialChange.r54Draft: Previously reconciled, unpublished and unchanged in this phase

exactNextAction: Pass V456 evidence-only exact-head CI, merge and validate postmerge; independently validate owner Windows recovery path and graceful CFON stop, then R54 SHA-pinned physical install with verified preservation and rollback. No owner session disconnection without that proof.
